newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 25,000/T, Aug 10-14 gasoline.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 25,000/T, Aug 10-14 gasoline.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of 87.15 octane leaded gasoline for delivery to Kandla on the east coast of India, industry sources said on Thursday.
The cargo is for delivery between August 10-14.
The tender will close July 24 and will be valid for one day.
In its last tender, IOC bought one 25,000 tonnes gasoline cargo for June 18-22 delivery at $43 per tonne over Mideast naphtha quotes and another at over $30 per tonne premium for June 26-30 delivery.
